'''May 2000 Cedar Knolls tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Knolls, NJ on 27 May 2000. It is known from Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-27-cedar-knolls-nj-5-27-00d814/ cedar-knolls-nj-5-27-00], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 27 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-27-cedar-knolls-nj-5-27-00d814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Knolls, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 16
